title: Refund eligibility
scenario: A student asks whether a course purchase is eligible for refund.
content: For A student asks whether a course purchase is eligible for refund., first identify the exact product, transaction, purchase state, and applicable refund or cancellation policy. Eligibility must be determined from an approved policy rather than a generic assumption. Access or consumption status may matter, and subscription cancellation may be different from a refund of a previous charge. If a refund is approved, explain processing separately from approval and do not claim settlement until the payment record confirms it. If the required policy is unavailable or the case is outside documented rules, route it for human review. Never invent a refund window, approval, amount, or completion date.
